title: HLSE Clipboard Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json clipboard "<copied>" "<pasted>"` — detects cryptocurrency address hijacking by clipper malware.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict.

is_swap.description: 1 if copied and pasted addresses are different; 0 if identical.

swapped.description: The address that was pasted (may differ if hijacked).

reason.description: Explanation of whether and why the addresses differ.

remediation.description: Guidance based on whether a swap was detected.

pattern_id.description: Stable SIEM/SOAR routing token (present iff pattern is present).

verify.description: Independent check before sending funds (score >= 60 only).

triage.description: Immediate response if funds were already sent (score >= 60 only).

cascade_risk.description: Other cryptocurrency at risk from clipper malware (score >= 60 only).
